spans.s:
mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
1 Entire, all, the whole.
2 Infinite, endless.
E.
अ neg. and शेष remainder.

ind.
Entirely, wholly.
E.
अशेष whole, तसि aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Charming, lovely.
E.
अ neg. सेचव satisfaction.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
See the preceding.
E.
आङ्, षिच to sprinkle, ल्युट् and कन् aff. also असेचनक.

n. (-नं)
1 Disregarding, neglecting.
2 Avoiding, shunning.
3 Disobedience, inattention.
E.
अ neg. सेवन service.

f. (-वा)
1 Avoiding, not following or practising.
2

Disobedience.
E.
अ neg. सेवा service: see the last.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Neglected, unattended to, disobeyed.
2 Abstained from, disused.
E.
अ neg. सेवित served, used.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 Not to be served or attended to.
2 Not to be used or practised, not to be eaten, drank, &c.
E.
अ neg. सेव्य to be followed.

m. (-कः)
Sprinkling.
E.
आङ् before षिच to sprinkle, affix घञ्.

n. (-नं)
Sprinkling.
mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Beloved, desired.
E.
आङ्, षिच to sprinkle, ल्युट् affix; also आसेचनक.

m. (-द्धा)
One who confines or arrests another.
E.
आङ् before षिध to go, and तृच् aff.

m. (-धः)
Arrest, legal restraint of four kinds; कालामेधः limit of time, स्थानामेधः confinement to a place, प्रवासासेधः prohibition against removal or departure, कर्म्मासेधः restriction from employment.
E.
आङ् before षिध to go, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं)
To be interrupted, prohibited or restrained.
E.
आङ् before षिध to go, यत् aff.
